Past performance may or may not be sustained in future. IDCW is on face value of Rs. 1000/- per unit. Face value changed
from Rs. 10/- to Rs. 1,000/- w.e.f. close of business hours on April 18, 2013. IDCW declared prior to face value change is on
face value of Rs. 10/- per unit. After the payment of IDCW, the per unit NAV will fall to the extent of Payout of Income
Distribution cum capital withdrawal option and applicable statutory levy, if any.
